<style>
#quarto-header, .navbar, .quarto-navbar, .page-footer, .nav-footer { display: none !important; }

  color: #555;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.institution-header {
  padding: 0.5rem 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e0e0e0;

.institution-header h3 {

}

  font-size: 0.88rem;

.institution-body { padding: 0.5rem 0; }
.institution-body table {
  width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.95rem;
  --bs-table-bg: transparent;
  --bs-table-color: #333;
  --bs-table-striped-bg: transparent;
  --bs-table-hover-bg: #fdf6f6;
  background-color: transparent !important;
  color: #333 !important;
}
.institution-body table thead tr { background-color: #f2f2f2 !important; }
.institution-body table th { text-align: left; padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #4C0000 !important; border-bottom: 2px solid #ccc !important; }
.institution-body table td { padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #ebebeb !important; vertical-align: middle; color: #333 !important; background-color: transparent !important; }
.institution-body table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none !important; }
.institution-body table tr:hover td { background-color: #fdf6f6 !important; }

.cake-photo { text-align: center; margin: 1rem 0 2rem 0; }
.cake-photo img { border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); max-width: 60%; }
.cake-photo p { font-size: 0.88rem; color: #777; margin-top: 0.5rem; font-style: italic; }

body.quarto-dark .teaching-intro,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .teaching-intro { color: #aaa !important; }

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .teaching-intro { color: #aaa; }

  .institution-header span { color: #aaa !important; }

  .institution-body table { --bs-table-bg: transparent; color: #ccc !important; }
  .institution-body table thead tr { background-color: #2a2a2a !important; }
  .institution-body table th { color: #f0a0a0 !important; border-bottom-color: #555 !important; }
  .institution-body table td { color: #ccc !important; background-color: transparent !important; border-bottom-color: #333 !important; }
  .institution-body table tr:hover td { background-color: #2a2020 !important; }
}

body.quarto-dark .institution-header h3,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .institution-header h3 { color: #f0f0f0 !important; }

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .institution-header span { color: #aaa !important; }

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .institution-body table { --bs-table-bg: transparent; color: #ccc !important; background-color: transparent !important; }

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .institution-body table thead tr { background-color: #2a2a2a !important; }
body.quarto-dark .institution-body table th,

html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .institution-body table td { color: #ccc !important; background-color: transparent !important; border-bottom-color: #333 !important; }
body.quarto-dark .institution-body table tr:hover td,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .institution-body table tr:hover td { background-color: #2a2020 !important; }

@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .cake-photo img { max-width: 90%; }

  .institution-body table { font-size: 0.8rem; }

  .institution-body table td { padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; }
}

<p class="teaching-intro">I love teaching — over the years I have learned a great deal from my students, both in Germany and in Bangladesh. Below I share some of the materials I have prepared for my courses.</p>

<img src="img/students_cake_MAT211_STH.jpeg" alt="Students' cake"/>
